sources.entry: DevLint - A lightweight app for formatting and correcting Swift syntax.

summary.one_liner: DevLint is a lightweight native macOS app for editing, formatting, and checking Swift code, now paused with no active development.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a native macOS code editor for Swift with syntax highlighting for keywords, types, operators, and comments. It has an editable scrollable text editor with line numbers and auto-indentation/formatting that adjusts spacing and structure. Error detection that highlights syntax mistakes is listed as work in progress. Bracket matching for {}, (), and [] is marked as coming soon. Planned items include SwiftLint integration, theme and font customization, multi-tab support, and a Swift Playground mode. The README notes development is paused but the project remains open to contributions.
use_cases: editing Swift source files on macOS
checking Swift code for syntax errors
experimenting with Swift in a lightweight editor
notable: Native macOS app focused on Swift only
Built-in Swift syntax highlighting and line-numbered editor
Planned SwiftLint integration with auto-fix suggestions
caveats: Development is currently paused, per the README
Error detection and bracket matching are incomplete or not yet built
No build or install instructions in the README
